subject.title: Control UI: Pinned context panel for user-defined persistent facts

question: Should pinned user facts be a first-party Control UI/memory feature now, folded into the broader memory-file panel, or deferred until the Control UI plugin contribution-slot RFC defines a panel seam?
rationale: The code already has raw allowlisted file editing, but the requested key-value facts editor changes persistent context and sensitive user data behavior, so automation cannot safely choose the storage and injection contract.

options.title: Keep as canonical pinned-facts design
options.body: Use this issue to settle the pinned-fact storage, injection, stale-fact, and security contract before any implementation PR is queued.

options.title: Fold into memory panel
options.body: Treat the first version as part of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/46809 if maintainers want MEMORY.md/USER.md editing to own the UX.

options.title: Defer to plugin panel seam
options.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/71736 if maintainers want memory/context panels to be plugin-contributed rather than core-owned.

recommendation.title: Keep as canonical pinned-facts design
recommendation.body: Use this issue to settle the pinned-fact storage, injection, stale-fact, and security contract before any implementation PR is queued.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current-history signal across the Agents files UI, gateway file path, and memory/context routing boundaries.
